difficulty_reason: Derived completeness of the quasi-coherent derived category of a formal-neighborhood stack: uses X = colim Spec(A/I^n) as an fppf sheaf, the Formal Spaces factorisation lemma to see every affine object factors through some Spec(A/I^n), the full subcategory C of those thickenings, and identifies (C, O|_C) with the ringed site (N, (A/I^n)) so that Differential Graded Sheaves, derived-complete applies; the I^n != I^{n+1} simplification is stated explicitly. Retained author proof at lines 5151-5174.
